item.title: In photos: President attends National Children’s Day ceremony in Tehran
item.description: A ceremony to mark National Children’s Day was held at the Institute for the Intellectual Development of Children and Young Adults in Tehran on Sunday, October 11, 2026. President Masoud Pezeshkian, Minister of Education Alireza Kazemi, and several other officials attended the celebrations with hundreds of cheering, joyful kids.

item.title: Supertanker explodes after hitting mine in ‘unauthorized’ Hormuz route: IRGC Navy

item.title: ‘Don’t let my friends be forgotten’: Surviving Minab student writes to Araghchi

item.title: Security chief: US response to Iran’s 7 conditions ‘insufficient’
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said Sunday that the Americans have responded to the seven conditions Iran has put forward for ending the war and opening the Strait of Hormuz, but that Tehran considers their response insufficient.

item.title: Senior Iranian authorities hold meeting
item.description: The heads of Iran’s three branches of government met on October 11, 2026, at a session hosted by President Pezeshkian, with Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf and Judiciary Chief Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Ejei, to review the country’s latest developments and discuss key ongoing issues.
